contracts.signal: 10-Q: under the Lilly-Ajax agreement, Ajax shareholders could receive up to $2.3 billion in cash, inclusive of an upfront payment and subsequent payments upon certain clinical and regulatory milestones. Schrödinger's approximately $57.2 million cash payment comprised $47.2 million for its equity stake in Ajax and $10.0 million from a collaboration milestone payment; it is also eligible for potential cash payments held in escrow related to the closing, and it recognized an unrealized gain of approximately $42.1 million on its Ajax investment in Q2 2026.
